decisions.rationale: Lead Arcanine + Garchomp to attack before Trick Room sets. Intimidate weakens Metagross; Flare Blitz and Earthquake are SE and likely OHKO. Blaziken Speed Boosts past TR, Rotom-Wash burns and pivots. Intended Mega: none (opponent's Metagrossite is the only Mega).

Tinkaton and Starmie are alternate options if opponent leads non-TR. Game 1: observe opponent's lead to infer game 2 patterns.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf sets TR under Armor Tail+Mental Herb. Primarina immune to Dragon/Intimidate, OHKOs Garchomp with Ice Beam, can Protect if doubled. Metagross (Clear Body blocks Intimidate, Mega Tough Claws under TR) and Sinistcha (Matcha Gotcha 4x Rotom-W, Strength Sap) sweep endgame. Mega Metagross is the Mega; Primarina special avoids Intimidate entirely.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Arcanine (Intimidate/Sitrus), Garchomp (LO/RoughSkin/Jolly), Starmie (FocusBand/Analytic/Timid), Blaziken (Sash/SpeedBoost/Adamant), Tinkaton (Leftovers/MoldBreaker/Jolly, FakeOut), Rotom-Wash (ChartiBerry/Levitate/Timid). Even if Arcanine Protects, Rotom-Wash damage into Sinistcha is negligible (Volt Switch 10-25%, Hydro Pump 16-39%).

Arcanine takes only 0.5x from Matcha Gotcha and likely triggers Sitrus Berry. This maximizes survival while pressuring Sinistcha KO.

reflections.summary: Lost because the team preview brought Blaziken and Arcanine into a Farigiraf/Metagross Trick Room core, leaving them outsped and highly vulnerable. Blaziken was instantly KO'd by a double Psychic/Zen Headbutt target after a failed consecutive Protect, and Arcanine was picked off by Farigiraf and Sinistcha while Rotom-Wash's Protect failed.
reflections.adjustment: Lead with Rotom-Wash and Garchomp to apply immediate offensive pressure and force Protects on Turn 1, rather than exposing Blaziken to a double Psychic target. Use Blaziken only to clean up after Trick Room expires or to safely pressure Primarina.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads Farigiraf/Metagross Trick Room core. Farigiraf holds Mental Herb and uses Armor Tail, frequently using Protect to stall Trick Room turns. Metagross holds Metagrossite and Clear Body. Primarina holds Life Orb and Torrent; Sinistcha holds Sitrus Berry and Hospitality. Opponent prioritizes double targeting vulnerable physical attackers with Psychic and Zen Headbutt. Future plan: Lead Rotom-Wash and Garchomp to apply immediate pressure and force early Protects, avoiding exposing Blaziken to double Psychic targets. Utilize Arcanine's Intimidate to soften Metagross's physical attacks.

reflections.summary: Opponent brought a fast hyper-offense team without any Trick Room countermeasures, leaving Mold Breaker Tinkaton on the bench. This allowed Farigiraf to set Trick Room safely and sweep with strong slow attackers under the remaining turns.
reflections.adjustment: For game 2, expect Tinkaton to be brought to Fake Out Farigiraf. Lead Farigiraf with a partner that can pressure Tinkaton (e.g., Primarina's Moonblast) and Protect Farigiraf on turn 1 to block the flinch. Consider whether Mega Metagross is the safest bring, as it remains weak to the opponent's Fire moves.
reflections.notebook: G1: Opp brought Arcanine/Garchomp/Blaziken/Rotom-W. Starmie(FocusBand/Analytic/Timid) and Tinkaton(FakeOut/MoldBreaker/Leftovers) benched. Tinkaton's Mold Breaker bypasses Armor Tail—Fake Out will flinch Farigiraf. Farigiraf's Attack fell from Intimidate; Armor Tail does not block Intimidate, only Clear Body did on Metagross. Arcanine Sitrus consumed. Blaziken Focus Sash consumed, Speed Boost. Garchomp Life Orb. Rotom Charti Berry, Volt Switch pivot. Opponent tends to Protect predicted super effective hits. G2: Opp likely brings Tinkaton+Starmie to stop Trick Room; prepare for Fake Out lead and fast Analytic special attacks. Opp down 0-1 in series.
